name: events-check-since
description: Retro-check for matching events since a prior events-wait cursor: pass its sinceEventId + sinceTimestampUtc and the same contains/marker. Returns all matches in the window, not just the first. Use to recover after a wait timed out.

sinceEventId.description: Only events after this id (from the prior events-wait).

sinceTimestampUtc.description: startedAtUtc from the prior events-wait; events must be newer than both this and sinceEventId.

maxEntries.description: Max number of matching events to return.

source.description: Advanced: restrict to one event origin. Defaults to any source.

type.description: Advanced: restrict to one internal event type.

level.description: Advanced: restrict by severity (e.g. Error, Warning, Log).

includeData.description: Include each event's structured data payload in the result.
